criteria.text: The top bar uses the existing wide Bahia logo assets at a visibly larger size, and the Pending Approvals nav item no longer shows the demo alert badge.

Environment States shows service and environment names instead of ID hashes, exposes the underlying IDs on hover, and links directly to the requested service/environment detail routes when those names are clicked.
Recent Activity labels the time column with the local timezone, shows UTC time on hover, shows richer event information on hover, and opens a full event-detail dialog on click.
Recent Activity entity items show shortened service/environment names rather than raw IDs when that metadata is available.
Service-secret unavailability messaging refers to encrypted Nostr events and Settings rather than fictional encrypted requests or a nonexistent nostr.browser_relays setting requirement for this flow.

coverage_notes: Recent-activity entity naming now prefers event-payload names before falling back to store lookups, which avoids showing IDs during hydration races.
The broader legacy service-secrets smoke suite is stale and tracked separately as beads issue bahia-1u2u.
